name: Illustrator

sections.daily_work: Create original artwork for books, magazines, advertisements, games, and digital media. Develop characters, scenes, and visual narratives using both traditional and digital tools.
sections.learning: Drawing fundamentals, anatomy, perspective, digital illustration tools (Procreate, Adobe Illustrator), storytelling through visuals, portfolio development.
sections.pay: Varies by specialty and experience. Freelance illustrators may charge per project or per piece. Entry-level often starts around $30,000-$45,000 USD. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Art school or self-taught, building a strong portfolio, networking with art directors, submitting work to publications and agencies, freelance platforms.

try_in_real_life: Illustrate a short story or poem with 3-5 images
Create a character design sheet with different poses and expressions
Study different illustration styles and try recreating one you admire
Share your artwork online and seek feedback from artist communities
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
